parts:
Hi Phil:

I am starting in the IRT analysis and in one of the analyzes that I carried out I got the following Test Information Function (See Figure 1). My question is: what could be indicating these highs and lows in the TIF? Is the scale not very stable?
It is a data of more than 5000 university students from different faculties and a 7-item test

Greetings from Peru
Jose Ventura

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: TIF Interpretation
parts:
Hi Jose,

This is likely due to a few items having very high slope parameters (the a1's from coef(mod) ). It's unlikely that this output is reliable since large slopes tend to have large sampling variability, so you might want to consider placing a Bayesian prior on these values to deter this type of solution. HTH.

Phil
